items.text: The #SummitAmericas should not be an empty, partisan exercise; American leaders who care about our national security, and the Americas, should be included and involved.

Today, I sent a letter to @IRF_Ambassador condemning the alarming escalation of suppression of religious freedom in #Nicaragua & requesting info on what @StateIRF is doing to support the people of Nicaragua who seek to exercise the fundamental right of religious expression. https://t.co/peG1oG9iuW

Today, I proudly voted for the "Limit, Save, Grow Act," which will limit future spending by returning discretionary spending to pre-pandemic levels while maintaining a robust national defense and protecting Medicare and Social Security.

It was great meeting with the Florida Bankers of America 🏦 during their visit to Capitol Hill! We dove into critical topics impacting our state and nation, such as the surging insurance costs, house affordability in FL, and essential banking policies. I am grateful for the productive discussion.

Proud to have voted for the passage of H.R. 4531, renewing the SUPPORT for Patients and Communities Reauthorization Act. This vital legislation ensures continued substance use and opioid use disorder treatment and recovery services to millions of struggling Americans. We must use all viable means to combat the opioid and fentanyl epidemic plaguing our nation.

Sending my best wishes for a swift recovery to my dear friend and mentor, the Dean of the House @RepHalRogers. Your guidance has been invaluable, and I look forward to seeing you back in good health soon.

I am proud to have played a vital role in the reopening of the only wastewater treatment facility in Everglades City.🌊🏞️  The plant was already in need of repairs, and damages by Hurricanes Irma and Ian only made things worse, risking spillage into environmentally sensitive areas like Ten Thousand Islands and Everglades National Park.  Through my work in the House Appropriations Committee, I secured over $6.5 million in federal funding, which, in close collaboration with the State of Florida, helped reopen the facility and also rehabilitate lift stations in Everglades City, Chokoloskee, Carnestown, and Copeland.  Thank you, Mayor Howie Grimm and City Clerk Dottie Joiner, for your leadership and patience as well as State Senator Kathleen Passidomo and Collier County Commissioner Bill McDaniel for their efforts.  This project is crucial for the entire region, protecting both the environment and people’s quality of life by preventing sewage spills during major storms.

I am deeply concerned for the health of Williams Dávila, former deputy of Venezuela’s National Assembly. The Maduro dictatorship ruthlessly suppresses all dissent, including through imprisonment, torture, and arbitrary killings. Mr. Dávila must receive adequate medical care, and be left unharmed. The Venezuelan people have roundly rejected the Maduro regime’s multiple failures, corruption, and brutal repression. It is past time that their basic rights and freedoms be respected, and that activists such as Mr. Dávila are free to speak against the many abuses of the Maduro dictatorship without fear of persecution.

Congratulations to my colleague and former Representative, @DrDaveWeldon! Dr. Weldon is an excellent choice to lead the CDC. His leadership will bring accountability, restore trust, and ensure that Americans have access to essential public health resources and protections.

I am proud to once again support legislation that would create a unique zip code for the Town of Miami Lakes.

For far too long, Miami Lakes residents have faced significant challenges due to the lack of their own zip code. This has led to higher insurance premiums, confusion during elections and the census, and other costly and burdensome issues affecting my constituents.

This is the third time I successfully get this bill passed in the House and I will continue my efforts until the Senate passes this measure as well.

Congratulations to my dear friend, Benjamin Leon Jr., a true titan in the healthcare field, who is making a profound difference in the lives of seniors and families in Miami-Dade County. 

As an outstanding member of the exiled Cuban-American community, he consistently gives back, advocating for freedom and standing up for those who are oppressed. 

Benjamin embodies the American dream and is a true patriot who will represent U.S. interests with great honor in Spain.

I am profoundly concerned about Loreto Hernandez Garcia, the brother to dear friend and former political prisoner Jorge Luis Garcia Perez Antunez. Loreto has been imprisoned since participating in the July 11 protests, and his family is alarmed that his health is deteriorating. The brutal regime in Cuba continues to imprison courageous pro-democracy activists who dare to speak out against it. I demand his immediate and unconditional release, and the release of all political prisoners in Cuba. The Cuban regime must be held accountable for its crimes.

🇺🇸This week, I was proud to support the passage of a series of bills that honor our Veterans –– from ensuring access to affordable education and health research to modernizing key benefits that support their families and loved ones.

These brave men and women have risked it all in defense of our freedoms. It’s our duty to ensure they are treated with the dignity, care, and support they need.
